business_process: Reservoir and spillway gate operations (including flood passage)
description: Set gate openings to follow the reservoir operating plan and pass floods; keep the reservoir within license limits
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Life safety: loss of gate control during a flood could overtop the dam; a wrong opening sends a surge toward the downstream town. Operators can run gates from local panels, so the MTD is the time to staff all 4 panels and confirm positions. RPO covers reservoir and gate-position history in the historian
manual_workaround: Operators run gates from the 4 local panels with radio contact; hand-cranked or standby-generator operation; reservoir read from staff gauges
dependent_third_parties: Upstream county structure operator (flow coordination); SCADA integrator
dependent_people_or_facilities: Operators (minimum 3 on site during floods); Operations Supervisor; spillway; standby generator

business_process: Dam safety monitoring and EAP early warning
description: Read instruments against trigger points; detect developing failure modes; sound sirens and make EAP notifications
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Life safety and 18 CFR 12.10 (unusual instrumentation readings are reportable). Data loggers buffer readings for 30 days so little data is lost, but trend review stops. Sirens also have local activation at each siren pole
manual_workaround: Manual instrument readings every 4 hours by dam safety technicians; siren activation from the local poles; EAP phone tree
dependent_third_parties: Instrumentation SaaS vendor; county emergency management; siren maintenance contractor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Dam safety technicians; Chief Dam Safety Engineer

description: Start, load, and stop the 3 units to the offtaker's schedule; protect the units
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $37,800 of generation revenue per day at average output; units can be run locally at reduced flexibility; water not used for generation passes through the spillway, which BP-01 must manage
manual_workaround: Local unit control from the unit panels with an operator at each unit; reduced output

business_process: Physical security monitoring and access control
description: Cameras, card access, patrols, and suspicious activity reporting
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Security Group 2 Security Plan requires threat-level response; loss of cameras raises exposure at the spillway; incidents must reach the FERC Regional Office usually within one working day
manual_workaround: Extra patrols; posted security officer at the spillway gate; manual key control
dependent_systems: Camera system; card access system; SYS-07
dependent_third_parties: Security systems service contractor; county sheriff

description: Receive schedules, send MW telemetry through the RTU, reconcile monthly settlements
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract penalties for schedule deviations; operators can confirm schedules by phone
manual_workaround: Phone confirmation of schedules with the offtaker's control center; manual meter reads for settlement

business_process: Corporate communications and email (including emergency communications)
description: Email, chat, phone, and mass notification to staff
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Staff coordination during storms and incidents; FERC and offtaker correspondence
manual_workaround: Personal phones and the printed contact list; radio at the site
dependent_third_parties: Productivity and identity SaaS vendors; ISP

description: 12.10 reports, EAP updates, license compliance filings, Security Plan and certification letter, Part 12 inspections
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deadlines are in days (12.10 initial report as soon as practicable, preferably within 72 hours); reports can be made by phone if systems are down
manual_workaround: Phone and email reports from personal devices; paper copies of the EAP and Security Plan
dependent_people_or_facilities: Chief Dam Safety Engineer; Compliance and Security Coordinator

description: Work orders, preventive maintenance, parts inventory
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deferred maintenance is tolerable for days; critical spares must be findable during an outage
manual_workaround: Paper work orders; printed critical spares list

business_process: Hydro field services to other dam owners
description: Schedule crews, record job data, invoice customers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $17,600 of field services revenue per working day; customer outage windows are fixed weeks ahead
manual_workaround: Crews work from printed job packets; invoice later

description: Campground and marina reservations, fees, visitor safety
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Seasonal; walk-in registration possible; license requires public recreation access, and security closures over 30 days need FERC coordination
manual_workaround: Walk-in paper registration; cash and card terminal offline mode

description: Payables, receivables, payroll, onboarding and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Biweekly payroll for 187 employees; terminations must still remove OT access same day (POL-02)
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the payroll vendor; manual termination checklist
